title: Rate Limits
description: Read-only inventory of the organization- and workspace-scoped rate limits a gateway or proxy must keep in sync. Sourced from the Anthropic Rate Limits API (read-only); this view never changes a limit.

caveats.keepInSync: Gateways/proxies must keep in sync: these limits are the inventory an upstream gateway or proxy must mirror. They are not enforced here, and changing them is done at the provider, not in this console.
caveats.managedAgents: Managed Agents are NOT covered by the Rate Limits API. Their limits are a documented gap, not a value of zero — no Managed-Agents row is shown because the API does not report one.

summary.title: Sync status
summary.description: How many rate limits a gateway or proxy must keep in sync, as reported by the read-only governance ingest.

degraded.title: Admin-API governance ingest unavailable
degraded.hint: This deployment surface (for example a Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry gateway) does not expose the Anthropic Admin API, so the rate-limit inventory cannot be read here. This is honest unavailability, not an empty inventory.

inventory.title: Per-limiter inventory
inventory.description: Each limiter the provider reports, grouped by scope: organization-wide groups first, then workspace override groups.
inventory.unavailableHint: The read-only Admin connector is not wired, so the per-limiter inventory cannot be read here. This is honest unavailability, not an empty inventory.
inventory.emptyHint: The provider returned no per-limiter entries for this organization.

rateLimitInventory.title: No rate limits reported yet
rateLimitInventory.description: Entries appear once the read-only Anthropic Rate Limits API returns per-limiter limits for this organization.
